text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I headed to the meeting spot
where I'd promised to meet Matikane Fukukitaru, when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!?
choice_data_list: What happened!?
What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-It came out...! It really did!
Ten Great Blessings in a row from the fortune keychains!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it!
With this racing outfit, my lucky power is super mega-boosted!
Right?!
choice_data_list: Is it thanks to the power of the racing outfit?
Is it thanks to the power of the racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! This racing outfit is my ultimate gear,
loaded to the brim with clover patterns, lucky charms,
and good-luck goods gathered from all over...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of testing its power out in town, but now there's no need to even verify it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day! I want to put all this overflowing luck
towards something big!
choice_data_list: How about helping someone out?
How about lending someone a hand?
Please, grant me good fortune!
Please, grant me good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day! I want to put all this overflowing luck
towards something big!
choice_data_list: How about helping someone out?
How about lending someone a hand?
Please, grant me good fortune!
Please, grant me good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's so cool!
Now then, let's go look for someone in need...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*...!
W-What should I do...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!?
S-Someone's already in trouble!?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, Lucky...!
Lucky ran away...!"
...Upon asking for details, it turned out that while walking their dog, they had accidentally let go of the leash.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, for her name to be Lucky-chan...
I feel like this must be fate!
choice_data_list: This is truly your time to shine.
This is truly your moment to shine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "...You're so right! Leave it to me, Matikane Fukukitaru, to find that Lucky-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: R-Really...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...After all, right now,
I am an Umamusume who attracts the ultimate good luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, when it comes to dogs, asking a dog is best!
I have a komainu charm in my bag, so let's do a fortune-telling!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, putting this here... Chow Chow puppy, Shiba puppy...!

text_block_list.name: Shiba Inu
text_block_list.text:
(*tip-tap-tap.*
...*munch*)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaah!?
H-Hey, doggy!
Gi-Give Lord Komainu baaaack~~~!!
A Shiba Inu suddenly appeared, snatched a guardian dog statue in its mouth, and ran off... but taking a closer look...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh?!
That girl is on a leash!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could that girl be Lucky-chan?!
H-Hurry, let's go after her!
Though we managed to find Lucky, she was sitting in a troublesome spot near the entrance of the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmm, if we corner it carelessly and it runs into a store, it might cause a huge ruckus...
choice_data_list: Isn't there some lucky charm to summon it?
Isn't there some lucky charm to summon it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I often send psychic waves via incantations, but...
To be honest, doing it with a dog is a first for me...
choice_data_list: With my luck power right now, I can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I-I understand!
It's true, when it comes to luck, I should be invincible right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Kieeeeee!
Doberman, Mastiff, Malamute!
Leonberger, shovel car!"
And so... whether the telepathic waves worked or not, after about ten minutes, they managed to catch Lucky as he wandered closer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky
text_block_list.text: ...*whimper*

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank goodneeess...! Big sisters, thank you so so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome. Ehehe...
I guess you could say good luck just brought us together.
choice_data_list: She's an Umamusume like a goddess of good luck, after all.
She's an Umamusume like a goddess of good luck, after all.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Really!? Big sis, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...
E-Ehehe. I-It's not that big a deal~.
choice_data_list: Oh, blessed Lady Fukukitaru~!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Praise be~...!
Um, Lady Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu. I-If you ever need help again,
just leave it to me!
With my super lucky powers, it'll be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess I took the joke a bit too far.
Man, how embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "...Getting praised by you and that girl just made me really happy. Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, the good-luck power of this outfit
has been proven! I'll do my best wearing this
in the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe she'll even be
watching too, right!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? So I just need to share
some of my power with you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Please, please bring us good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmm, e-even if you say that... What are we supposed to do, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: Dear gods, Buddha, and Matikanefukukitaru-sama~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I-I guess there's no helping it then~!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then! I shall infuse this lucky charm
with my luck power...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nun-nun, funu-funu, funyanyanyari~!
There you go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This is~... well, believe it or not,
a charm that guarantees you'll win when you eat winning-stick ice cream!"
...That's a pretty down-to-earth effect.

...So, just how effective was this powered-up charm?
I decided to buy an ice cream and test it out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...A winner! Congra~tulations!
Hehehe, it looks like it's having a wonderful effect!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Another winning ticket!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...A-Another jackpot!?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Th-the whole stock was winning tickets...? Hmm,
that really shouldn't be possible..."

"As I stand there utterly bewildered,
a man who looks on the verge of collapsing enters the shop."

text_block_list.name: Man in Rags
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ice cream...
Give me... ice cream...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-I'm so sorry...
I actually just bought out
all the ice cream here~.

text_block_list.name: Man in Rags
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! Ugh... *thud*.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
A-Are you okay~!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!
Let's share one with them!

text_block_list.name: Man in Rags
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I feel revitalized.
I must find a way to repay you...

text_block_list.name: Man in Rags
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the ice cream... ice... cream... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Man in Rags
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I bestow this box upon you.
...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...They went and left.
I wonder what's inside this box?
choice_data_list: I'll try opening it for now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! T-Trainer, wait!
What if it's like an Urashima's box, a total danger item...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait... T-This is...!
An indigo smartphone!? And it's brand new in the box!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyoeeeeeh!?
Pl-plus, isn't this the latest model~?!
Don't tell me... he's no longer just limited to "ice cream," but can guess anything that contains the sounds "I," "C," and "E"...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-We can't just stand around!
Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: W-What?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just one charm gave you all that effect, you know?!
Imagine if you get two or three of them—just how much good fortune will rain down upon you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is our lucky chance!
Let's equip even moooore charms!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, first, a charm that lets you find spare change in your pocket whenever you're in trouble! And then, a charm for cleanly splitting chopsticks, and~...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh, enough already!
I'm just gonna infuse all of them with good luck power at once!

"...Afterward, decked out in charms all over
like badges of honor,
I had to walk through the town."
